source.title: Derry Journal, 6 June 1952, p. 6 ("Rural District of Londonderry: Election of Rural District Councillors (Returning Officer's notice)"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's notice of result, Derry Journal 6 Jun 1952 p6 (read in the BNA page image): divisions, surnames, other names, names of candidates elected, and in column 7 the retiring councillor deemed to be re-elected; no votes recorded (no polls). Also the News-Letter nomination report, 21 May 1952 p10.

note: Triennial election of the thirteen divisions of Londonderry (Derry) rural district, one member each, due 5 June 1952. There were no contests: twelve members were returned unopposed and in Glendermott, where no nomination was received, the retiring councillor was deemed re-elected (Returning Officer's notice, Derry Journal, 6 June 1952, p. 6). The earlier record filed these members under their places of abode instead of their divisions; corrected from the notice (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
